toolbar.runOptimizeTitle: Paste the default {depth} prompt into the last chat

queries.overWarnTitle: Show only queries at or over Warn at

charts.tokensHint: One bar per calendar day (oldest → newest). Height is the running total of tokens up to that day.
charts.costHint: Same days. Height is the running total of spend up to that day.
charts.codeLinesHint: AI-generated lines in this sample versus your git insertions on main/master, plus unmerged work on this branch. Bar length = line count (same scale).
charts.codeLinesAria: AI generated lines versus your lines on the default branch
charts.periodNote: Today, this month, and all time are from the Last N loaded queries — not the full Cursor dashboard.

optimize.savingsNote: Projected cost saved on a similar request. Stays 0 / 0.00 $ until you Run Optimize and press Start.
optimize.flowHint: Typical flow: a query lights up red (Warn at) → Run Optimize in the toolbar (default depth) pastes into that last chat — or open this tab, expand a colored card, preview, and Run that depth. After Start, savings land in .ai/optimize-savings.md. Expand the card above for the projected cost on a similar request and credited totals per project.
optimize.quickBlurb: Short prompt — why the last turn burned, three next-message tips.
optimize.balancedBlurb: Medium prompt — pattern, plan, small rules snippet for this chat.
optimize.deepBlurb: Full playbook — diagnosis, before/after, rules, savings clusters.
optimize.emptyNote: Refresh usage, then Run Optimize (toolbar) or a depth card.
optimize.clipboard: Optimize prompt copied — paste into the last Chat and press Start.

support.title: Fuel the tracker
support.lead: If Cursor Cost Tracker helps you catch expensive queries and save tokens, a coffee for the author goes a long way — it keeps late-night status-bar fixes and monthly forecasts brewing.
support.coffeeHint: One-time tip. Perfect when Optimize or the forecast just paid for itself.
support.coffeeBlurb: A warm cup keeps late-night status-bar fixes and monthly forecasts brewing.
support.linkNotLive: That support link is not live yet — check back after the next release.

settings.languageHint: English is the default. The panel, status bar, and toasts update as soon as you change this.
settings.statusBarHint: The sample updates with the options below and uses example spend, not your live totals.
settings.statusBarHidden: Status bar hidden. Open history from the Command Palette.
settings.showStatusBarHint: Off hides every chip. History is still available from the Command Palette.
settings.showTodayHint: Show today’s spend and daily allowance beside Current.
settings.minimalModeHint: Minimal mode keeps Current and Refresh only.
settings.recentRequestsHint: Choose how many newest requests appear as separate chips (1–10). Hidden in Minimal mode.
settings.showWarningsHint: When off, the status bar and this table use no ! and no green/red colors.
settings.warnAtDescription: Tokens used by a single request
settings.warnAtHint: Enter thousands of tokens: 1k = 1,000 tokens. Minimum 1k; use − / + to change by 100k. Saves as you type or step.
settings.colorsHint: Good is the under-cap / no-spike state. Warning is at/over cap or a token spike. Defaults are darker on a light theme so they stay readable on the status bar.
settings.criticalHint: A modal dialog when the newest query reaches the token or dollar threshold. Each query is shown once. Independent of the status-bar ! warning.
settings.criticalValuesHint: Defaults are 10,000k tokens (10M) or $5. Use − / + to step (100k or $0.50), or type the full number. Values save when you leave the field, press Enter, or step — not while typing.
settings.burnHint: Sum billed spend in a short window ending now (not only today or the newest query). Dollar toasts need non-zero costUsd — included Pro events at $0 still show token throughput on Statistics.
settings.burnMinHint: Default 2 so a single expensive query stays the last-query critical alert. Values save when you leave the field, press Enter, or step — not while typing.
settings.toastHint: Toasts are non-blocking and do not stop Cursor. Critical is an error toast, not a second modal.
settings.showCodeLines: Show AI lines vs your git on main/master
settings.codeLinesHint: Statistics and Charts use the same window as Last N / From date. AI lines are local Cursor composer totals for this workspace. On default branch = your git author insertions. This branch = unmerged tree vs main/master. Merge % = on default ÷ AI. With branch % = (on default + this branch) ÷ AI. Not which AI lines survived review.
settings.budgetHint: How daily budget, Today, and the monthly forecast spread the remaining cycle. Working days is the default (~22 in September). Calendar days uses every day in the month (30 in September).
settings.optimizeHint: Default Optimize depth for the toolbar Run Optimize button. Each colored card on the Optimize tab can still Run its own depth. After Start, savings go to .ai/optimize-savings.md.
settings.showLastHint: Newest queries to load (100–10,000). Default is 1,000. Type the full number, then press Enter or leave the field. Ignored when From date is set.
settings.fromDateHint: Load every query from this local day (for example 1.09.2026 or the start of the month) through today. Empty uses Show last. Caps at 10,000.
settings.pollHint: How often to fetch Current and Today from Cursor (1–60 minutes). Default is 1. Press Enter, step, or leave the field to save.

stats.currentProBody: Included Cursor Models and Other Models this cycle — same bars as the dashboard.
stats.currentTeamBody: Dollar pool used / cap this billing cycle.
stats.todayProBody: Today’s share of included usage vs even monthly pace (100% ÷ days this month).
stats.todayTeamBody: Today’s queries vs remaining cycle ÷ weekdays left.
stats.todayTeamBodyCalendar: Today’s queries vs remaining cycle ÷ calendar days left.
stats.todayTeamNoBudget: No daily budget — the monthly dollar pool is empty.
stats.cacheHitHint: Share of prompt tokens reused from cache instead of billed as new input. Cached tokens cost less.

mtd.title: Monthly cost forecast
mtd.noBudget: This calendar month from Last N. No daily dollar budget to pace against.
mtd.noDays: No working day so far this month — weekend before the first weekday.
mtd.noDaysCalendar: No day so far this month.
mtd.forecastWorking: This calendar month from Last N. Forecast keeps the current working-day pace through month end.
mtd.forecastCalendar: This calendar month from Last N. Forecast keeps the current daily pace through month end.
mtd.hintPercent: Bars and solid lines are cumulative used (same 0–100% scale). Dashed lines are the forecast; dotted green lines are leftover budget to month end (Good color).
mtd.hintUsd: Bars and solid lines are cumulative spend (same dollar scale). Dashed lines are the forecast; dotted green lines are leftover budget to month end (Good color).
mtd.ariaPercent: Cumulative used, ideal budget, and month-end forecast
mtd.ariaUsd: Cumulative spend, ideal budget, and month-end forecast
mtd.toLastHintCalendar: Per remaining day to last the cycle
mtd.toLastHintWorking: Per remaining working day to last the cycle
mtd.noWorkingDaysLeft: No working days left this month
mtd.percentSpent: At least one included quota is already at 100%. On-demand usage may apply after that.
mtd.percentEarly: At this {pace}: {bits}. Dotted ideal lines show leftover budget spread evenly to month end.
mtd.percentOk: {bits}. Bars show cycle used vs 100%. Dotted ideal lines show leftover budget to month end.
mtd.usdSpentWorking: Month spend is already at the working-day budget ceiling for this month.
mtd.usdSpentCalendar: Month spend is already at the daily budget ceiling for this month.
mtd.usdEarly: At this {pace}: {bits}. Bars are cumulative dollars. Dotted ideal lines show leftover budget spread evenly to month end.
mtd.usdOk: {bits}. Bars are cumulative dollars. Dotted ideal lines show leftover budget to month end.
mtd.vsDailyBudget: This month vs {days} × daily budget ({sample} sample).
mtd.onPaceMtd: On pace with the MTD budget

burnRate.bannerBody: {cost} in the last {minutes} minutes ({mix}). Does not stop Cursor.
burnRate.toastWarning: High burn rate: {spent} in the last {duration} minutes ({mix}). Warning only — Cursor will keep running.
burnRate.toastCritical: Possible runaway cost: {spent} in the last {duration} minutes ({mix}). This does not stop Cursor. Check the active Agent run before continuing.

codeLines.infoWindowBody: Same window as Last N / From date in Settings.
codeLines.infoRateBody: Your git insertions on {branch} divided by AI lines for this repo in that window.
codeLines.infoLandedBody: On {branch} plus unmerged work on this branch, divided by the same AI lines — as if the branch had already landed.
codeLines.infoAllBody: Cursor dashboard Lines Edited (All) for your account in this window.
codeLines.infoReposBody: That account total split across local projects by composer activity. Cursor does not send a per-repo heatmap.
codeLines.infoAuthorsBody: Git insertions count only the identity you select. Default is the email on your Cursor account. Turn on Sum accounts to include more git emails from this branch.
codeLines.sumAccountsHint: Off: one identity. On: add every identity you check.
codeLines.noAuthors: No git authors on this branch in the current window.
codeLines.splitHint: Account total matches the Cursor dashboard. Projects share that total.
codeLines.splitHintLocal: Dashboard unavailable. Local composer totals only.
codeLines.composerState: Accepted AI add + remove (All on the dashboard)
codeLines.headers: The All-projects total is Cursor dashboard Lines Edited (same heatmap). Per-repo numbers split that total by local composer activity — Cursor does not send a per-repo heatmap. Git bars are this repo only.
codeLines.checkpoints: AI lines estimated from local agent checkpoints. Git counts use your author and the unmerged tree. Approximate only.
codeLines.edits: AI lines estimated from editor activity. Git counts use your author and the unmerged tree. Approximate only.
codeLines.gitOnly: AI attribution unavailable. Showing git insertions for your author and the unmerged tree.
codeLines.unavailable: Code line insight is unavailable for this workspace.

statusBar.cyclePoolNote: Cycle pool used / limit (not the sum of today's queries)
statusBar.todayNoBudget: Today = sum of today's queries. Cycle remaining is $0, so there is no daily budget. Today can exceed Current (events vs plan pool).
statusBar.todayVsCycle: Today = sum of today's queries vs remaining cycle allowance.
statusBar.todayVsDays: Today = sum of today's queries vs remaining cycle ÷ {unit} left ({days} days).

alerts.saveSetting: Could not save Cursor Cost setting: {message}
alerts.lastQuery: Last Cursor query used {tokens} tokens and cost {cost}.
alerts.exceedsBoth: This exceeds your critical alert of {tokenLimit} tokens or {costLimit}.
alerts.exceedsTokens: Tokens exceed your critical alert of {tokenLimit}.
alerts.exceedsCost: Cost exceeds your critical alert of {costLimit}.
alerts.notAskedAgain: You will not be asked about this query again.

findings.lastRedDetail: {model} used {tokens} tokens (≥ {threshold} — Optimize targets this chat).
findings.lastRedLowCacheDetail: Cache hit {hit}% on the last red query (under {limit}%).
findings.noRedDetail: No query in the last {n} is ≥ Warn at ({threshold} tokens). Lower Warn at in Settings or wait for a spike.
